classificationStatus: Phase 0 evidence-backed baseline; semantic tag definitions are Phase 2.

authoringSurfaces.DatabaseNote: Database-record note fields. Specific record kinds are carried in declaredContexts.
authoringSurfaces.EventPageComment: Event commands 108 and 408 on a specific event page.
authoringSurfaces.PluginCommand: Event command 356 or equivalent structured command insertion.
authoringSurfaces.MoveRouteScript: Movement route script commands and helpers.
authoringSurfaces.MessageTextCode: Caret-position insertion in message-capable text fields.
authoringSurfaces.SwitchNameMetadata: Metadata encoded in switch display names.
authoringSurfaces.VariableNameMetadata: Metadata encoded in variable display names.
authoringSurfaces.LunaticMode: Advanced JavaScript or formula blocks; never executed in the editor process.

coverageModes.TypedCatalog: A catalog definition plus reusable typed controls is expected.
coverageModes.SpecializedEditor: The feature requires an ordered or domain-specific editor.
coverageModes.ContextAssistant: The syntax is inserted from the editor surface where it executes.
coverageModes.PluginConfiguration: The plugin is represented in Plugin Manager intelligence.
coverageModes.RuntimeValidationOnly: No authoring syntax was detected; presence, version, and compatibility are still validated.

completionRules: Every normalized plugin must have one or more coverage modes.
Every conflicting duplicate must have an explicit resolution.
Every dependency edge must include evidence and a source location.
Unknown or unresolved dependencies remain visible; they are not silently discarded.
Source hashes may be distributed; plugin JavaScript and full help text may not.
Phase 0 declaredContexts are extraction signals and must be semantically reviewed before tag generation.
